source_full_text: The golden star, too, could not be removed from her forehead. But all the gold pieces she drew from her pockets had found their way to her mother and sister. I will go now and see what I can get out of the pussies said Peppina, the elder girl, one morning, As she took Lizina's basket and fastened her pockets into her own skirt.
